title: Yellowing Chewy Uruguayan Meat Empanadas
description: A traditional Uruguayan dish featuring palm sugar and a unique cooking method.

ingredients.name: Palm Sugar
ingredients.notes: dissolve in beef broth for marinade

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and place a bain-marie setup on the middle rack.
Combine ground beef, dissolved palm sugar, beef broth, and red wine (if using) in a large bowl.
Mix the ingredients with a fork until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the puff pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the egg wash and fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges to seal and use a fork to crimp the seam.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush the tops with beef tallow or oil.
Place the baking sheet in the preheated oven and cook for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.
